fact: As of July 2026 the national datacenter was still under construction at VITIB, while five public datacenters (SNDI, Presidency, VITIB, Education) hosted state data and the Ivorian-built ST Digital Tier III centre, inaugurated 2 October 2025, offered colocation.
title: Stockage de données : Les 10 datacenters en Côte d'Ivoire pour un début de souveraineté numérique
